# HandleMCP

> HandleMCP (also written handle-mcp) is an open-source MCP server for Danish grocery stores: nemlig.com and BilkaToGo (home delivery) and REMA 1000 (Køb & Hent pickup). An AI assistant can search products, read offers and recipes, price a whole shopping list in every store and fill the cheapest cart. It can never order, pay, choose a delivery time or change the address: the human always pays. Runs locally over stdio. MIT licence.

Works with any client that supports the Model Context Protocol, for example Claude Desktop and Claude Code. Logins stay on the user's machine (OS keychain). Names, addresses and phone numbers are removed from every tool answer. Unofficial: it uses the stores' private website APIs and is not affiliated with nemlig.com, Salling Group or REMA 1000.

## Pages (Danish)

For developers:
- [nemlig.com MCP](https://handlemcp.dk/nemlig-mcp/): setup for Claude Code and Claude Desktop, example prompts, nemlig.com's offer types, lessons from building against nemlig.com
- [BilkaToGo API](https://handlemcp.dk/bilkatogo-api/): BilkaToGo has no public API; how HandleMCP uses the website's own, BilkaToGo vs nemlig.com, five pitfalls (amounts in øre, errors with HTTP 200, login can replace the cart)
- [REMA 1000 MCP](https://handlemcp.dk/rema-1000-mcp/): REMA 1000 has no public API; search and offers without login, the shopping list "handle-mcp" as the cart (never the order or payment), REMA vs nemlig.com and BilkaToGo, five pitfalls (never resend a POST blindly, never read a list with its users, one product on two lines, ids as numbers and strings, short capitalised names)

For families:
- [AI madplan med budget](https://handlemcp.dk/ai-madplan-budget/): a meal-plan-on-a-budget prompt to copy, and what HandleMCP adds (real prices and offers)
- [Madkontoen hele måneden](https://handlemcp.dk/madkonto-hele-maaneden/): weekly amount = food account balance ÷ weeks left, five rules for making the food budget last the month
- [Billigere end måltidskasse](https://handlemcp.dk/billigere-end-maaltidskasse/): how to compare price per portion with a meal kit, and an honest comparison

## What it can do

nemlig.com and BilkaToGo, see [handlemcp.dk/#kan](https://handlemcp.dk/#kan):

- Read this week's offers, including free gifts and daily deals.
- Search products: price, price per kg/l, offers, the right number of packs.
- Price a whole shopping list in both stores, with delivery fees and minimum order, and name the cheapest.
- Plan within a budget the human gives, built on the offers.
- Read the stores' own recipes, with products and prices for the number of persons.
- Fill the cart after the human says yes. Only the cart.
- List free delivery times with the fee per slot, cheapest first. The human chooses.
- Read past orders, for "what we usually buy".
- Give one link to the cart, where the human checks and pays.

REMA 1000: search and offers without login; with login, Køb & Hent pickup times and the shopping list "handle-mcp" in REMA's app as the cart. The human turns the list into an order, picks the time and pays in REMA's app. No recipes yet.

## What it cannot do

- Order, pay, read payment cards, choose a delivery time or change the address. That code does not exist, and a test fails if it is added.
- See what is in the fridge. The human says it, or keeps a short list the AI reads.
- Promise a saving. It shows prices; what a family saves depends on its habits.
- Run without some setup today: it needs an MCP client and a terminal. A one-click version is planned (waitlist on the landing page).

## FAQ

The landing page has a short FAQ in Danish, also as FAQPage JSON-LD: [handlemcp.dk/#faq](https://handlemcp.dk/#faq).

- What is an MCP? A plug. The AI cannot see nemlig.com on its own. With HandleMCP it can search, read offers and fill the cart.
- How does it work? You write: "Meal plan for 4. Budget 900 kr. Use the offers." You get a plan, a list and the cheapest store. No spreadsheet, no app to learn.
- How do I correct the list? Say it in plain words ("we have milk", "chicken, not salmon"). Nothing goes in the cart before you say yes.
- How does it know what I have at home? It does not. You tell it, or keep a short list it reads each week. It can also read past orders.
- Offers and delivery? It reads this week's offers and plans around them. It shows free delivery times. You choose one yourself.
- What does it cost? Nothing. Free and open source. You need an AI app, for example Claude. Goods and delivery are paid to the store as usual.
- Most popular MCP for nemlig.com and BilkaToGo? HandleMCP: the most GitHub stars of any MCP for nemlig.com and BilkaToGo (November 2026), and it compares both stores in one cart.
- Can it order or pay? No. That code does not exist. The human approves and pays.
